algorithm.name: Attention row与闭合FFN同核原算子重排
algorithm.method: Exact closed attention rows and nonoverlapping raw-port-closed original four-op M/V/V/M FFN co-location; quotient EFT placement followed by fixed-owner original-op ready scheduling. One direct plan, one online E0; no search, fusion or cloning.

offline_costs: No training or case-specific scored precomputation. Prior structural census, model invariants and software tests are development work and used zero E0. No new packages/native compilation.
